verdict.rationale: Postmark documents a broad public REST API that covers sending, templates, bounces, message search, stats, servers, message streams, and domains, with token-header authentication and official SDKs. A community user confirms driving it directly with curl POST requests. missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec was found (all probed paths returned 404).
